Welcome in

A club with room for everyone

Grimstad Bokseklubb has been going since 1972. Beginners, fitness boxers and competitors train side by side – in the same ring and with the same respect.

We have our own ring, heavy bags and a small strength room. You do not need any experience to start. Show up in training clothes and we will help you get going.

  • Free trial session – just show up
  • Groups for young people and adults
  • Opportunities to compete
  • Coaches and volunteers with years of experience

What we offer

As many reasons as there are boxers

Whether you want to feel better, learn a new sport or compete, there is a session for you.

01

Beginners

Basic technique, footwork and punching at a calm pace.

02

Fitness

Conditioning, coordination and strength. No fights, just good training.

03

Competition

For members who want to compete. Technique, sparring and events.

04

Strength room

A small gym with weights and equipment you can use.

Training in Frivoldveien

Monday18:00–19:30Boxing, advancedTechnique and sparring for members with some experience.
